summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing RBI approval to purchase up to an additional 2% stake in its subsidiary ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company to maintain shareholding above 50%. The filing references a prior announcement on February 28, 2026, but does not state price per share, premium, or deal value. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The acquisition is subject to RBI conditions and regulatory compliance. What to watch: regulatory timeline and impact on minority shareholders.
